state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: Aggregating responses into correct, incorrect or abstain (Table 2), the authors find judges most accurate when not shown arguments and not strongly encouraged to abstain. After removing abstentions, a 2 × 2 × 2 repeated measures ANOVA (+/- argument × 1st/2nd judgment × incentive structure) finds no main effects and no interactions: none of the three factors significantly affects the rate at which judges are correct or incorrect.
title: Highest judge accuracy without arguments, though no factor has a significant effect
